text_block_list.text:
One day off, when I went to the shopping 
district... it was somehow even livelier 
than usual. At the center of it all was—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, please take one! Root for Haru 
Urara!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! You see, I was handing out 
flyers just now!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: Hello! Trainer, please have some too!

Taking a look at the flyer handed to me by 
someone from the shopping district...

"Send Urara-chan to the Arima Kinen! 
Please lend us your votes!"
...Or so it was written.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, you need fan votes to enter 
the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So everyone in my fan club said we should 
get the fans to vote!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, Urara-chan's gonna have a 
really tough time in the Arima Kinen, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
"So, we were just wondering if there was 
anything we could do to help..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
"Urara-chan always gives us so much 
energy, so we want to make her dream come 
true!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you, everyone! I'm definitely 
going to run in the Arima Kinen!

I took in the situation. It seemed the 
supporters' club had acted out of 
consideration for Haru Urara.

Haru Urara herself doesn't seem to really 
understand, though...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Urara-chan is aiming for the "Arima 
Kinen"? That sounds fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing, we'll help out! I'll ask my 
friends to pitch in too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thank you~! Make sure to vote a 
lot, okay!

"...Haru Urara is plenty popular right 
now. Indeed, if we keep gathering votes 
like this, she might actually make it into 
the Arima Kinen."
However—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's hand them out together, Trainer! 
It'll be fun!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...What is this?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can laugh about this...!

It was the Umamusume who had run alongside 
Haru Urara in the February Stakes. Looking 
at the flyer, she had a stern look on her 
face...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, long time no see! Right now, I'm 
handing out flyers!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I can tell just by looking. Is 
it... to run in the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! They told me I can't 
race as I am right now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why everyone's helping me out! 
Telling people to vote for me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Urara-chan. Do you really 
understand what you're doing?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Um... Getting everyone to vote, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And so, for the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —Don't make fun of me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's giving it their all because 
there's a race they want to run... Because 
there's a race they want to win.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And yet, what about Urara-chan...? Using 
other people, trying to easily obtain her 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare make fun of the Arima 
Kinen, of racing, or of us running with 
all our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I don't want an Urara-chan who isn't being 
serious... to run!!

Haru Urara could only watch in dazed 
silence as she ran off...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"...Thinking calmly about it, she's 
certainly right."

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I want Urara-chan to run, but an Umamusume 
has to earn her spot through real skill.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's just how the Arima Kinen 
goes. Still, I really wanted to see 
Urara-chan run in it, though~~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Why did I make her angry? Ugh, I don't 
get it at all...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: "...Sorry, Urara-chan. It's our fault."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Because we did whatever we wanted, 
Urara-chan ended up getting scolded by her 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: I'm truly sorry!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Why are you apologizing, mister~?! No way, 
you shouldn't apologize!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because, because I don't really get it, 
but... I don't really get it, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
“Even I can tell... that something about 
me isn't good enough...”

...In the end, handing out flyers was 
called off, and I decided to take Haru 
Urara home for the day.
